clauses.scope_note: Prohibits altering, removing, or obscuring licensing, copyright, or other notices of the licensor in the software.

obligation_items.content: Do not alter, remove, or obscure the licensor’s licensing, copyright, or other notices in the software.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever handling the software containing such notices.

clauses.scope_note: A written claim that the software infringes or contributes to infringement of a patent immediately ends the patent license. A claim by the licensee’s company ends the patent license for work on behalf of that company.

For a company claim, the stated scope is work on behalf of that company. The consequence is immediate termination of the patent license, not a stated termination of every copyright license.

obligation_items.content: Do not rely on the patent license after it has ended upon a qualifying written patent claim.

obligation_items.trigger: Whenever anyone gets a copy of any part of the software from the licensee.

clauses.scope_note: The duty is triggered by modifying the software and applies to any modified copies of the software. The notice must prominently state that the licensee modified it.
clauses.condition_explanation: A modified copy must include the prominent modification notice when distributed; the clause states the notice obligation for modified copies, not a requirement to distribute them.

obligation_items.content: Include a prominent notice stating that the licensee modified the software.
obligation_items.object: each modified copy of the software
obligation_items.trigger: If the licensee modifies the software, in any modified copy of the software.

clauses.scope_note: No licenses other than those expressly granted are implied. This is a boundary on the license grants, not an independent prohibition on an otherwise unlicensed act.

clauses.scope_note: Use in violation of the terms is not licensed and automatically terminates the licenses. This rule does not itself add a new substantive restriction beyond the license terms.
clauses.condition_explanation: The condition is any use that violates these terms; the stated consequences are that such use is unlicensed and the licenses automatically terminate.

obligation_items.content: Do not use the software in violation of the license terms.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the proposed use would violate a term of the license.

clauses.scope_note: If the licensor gives notice of a violation and the licensee ceases all violations within 30 days after receipt, the licenses are reinstated retroactively. This cure applies to the stated termination mechanism.
clauses.condition_explanation: Both notice from the licensor and cessation of all violations no later than 30 days after receipt are required for retroactive reinstatement.

obligation_items.content: Cease all violations of the license.
obligation_items.object: software use and conduct violating the license
obligation_items.trigger: After receiving the licensor’s notice of violation, no later than 30 days after receipt, to obtain the stated retroactive reinstatement.

clauses.scope_note: After retroactive reinstatement following the stated notice and timely cure, any subsequent violation causes automatic and permanent termination of the licenses.
clauses.condition_explanation: Both a prior reinstatement under the cure provision and a subsequent violation are required; the subsequent violation causes automatic permanent termination.

obligation_items.content: Do not use the software in violation of the license terms after reinstatement.
obligation_items.trigger: After licenses have been reinstated under the notice-and-cure provision.
